register: Reusable patterns that must have a story
note: QGD-FRM-0010. These exist so that a later application — Club's member list, Editor's forms — copies the pattern that is already here instead of inventing a second one, which is how a shell and the applications on it drift apart. scripts/storybook.mjs reports which are present on every run, so the state is visible while P3 is built rather than discovered at its exit gate.
